scope_evidence: Goldfish generic.mk packages composer3-service.ranchu for the SDK product, independently of minigbm selection. Device.cpp selects Ranchu host/guest/client/no-op composers. DrmClient.cpp OpenVirtioGpuDrmFd requires the virtio device name and Init requests universal-plane and atomic capabilities.

Pinned ACK amdgpu_dm_plane.c dm_plane_init_colorops registers pipelines only for DCN_VERSION_3_0 or newer outside AMD_PRIVATE_COLOR; amdgpu_dm_colorop.c initializes those hardware operations. Global constructor query and target initializer bodies examined together.

The separate local drm_hwcomposer consumer is positively identified. vendor.hwc.drm.enable_color_pipeline defaults false. When true it warns on capability failure, then rejects noncursor planes without COLOR_PIPELINE. Do not claim it transparently falls back. No equivalent SDK pipelines exist in ACK virtio/VKMS, so advertising the generic capability would not solve that unsupported configuration.

Common config disables AMDGPU, but the common distribution config is not evidence that external virtio/VKMS are disabled: both are m in virtual-device fragments and both .ko artifacts exist in build165.

Native atomic, plane, mode-object, connector, framebuffer and color-management source files touched by these candidates remain byte-identical to LTS, except drm_ioctl.c whose existing permission-policy change is independently reviewed. All native UAPI headers remain unchanged.

Ranchu HostFrameComposer requests host display transforms only when !isVirtioGPU and the host advertises support; it explicitly documents the virtio limitation. GuestFrameComposer applies a color matrix to its composed RGBA buffer. Neither establishes complete color-transform support in every mode. This is source evidence, not proof of visual output. Native CRTC/plane legacy color interfaces remain.

Final ACK 9524ac5814b2 additionally rejects pipeline capability with EOPNOTSUPP when no plane has a pipeline; native uses EINVAL. See drm-interface-review.json for this explicit errno difference and preserved legacy properties.
limitations: No Android build, emulator boot, display test, AMD platform support or arbitrary vendor composer configuration is verified. Omission is specific to the SDK target and its present driver/provider contract, not universal dispensability of color pipelines. Commit-message/RFC URLs were not accessed.
